exposure: PASUSS score (placenta accreta spectrum ultrasound scoring system)
clinical staging of PAS (placenta accreta spectrum)
cohort: The study examined 430 individuals with singleton pregnancies, anterior placenta previa (APP), a prior cesarean section (CS), and prenatal suspicion of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) as determined by PASUSS.
finding: Independent risk factors for massive transfusion during cesarean section included emergency surgery, PASUSS score, preoperative hemoglobin level, clinical staging of PAS, and one-step conservative surgery, which were used to develop an effective prediction model.
